criteria.name: template_first_no_retroactive
criteria.description: TEMPLATES.md and BRIEF-TEMPLATES.md read BEFORE any artifact is written. GitHub issue comments, ACs, agent briefs, and completion reports use the template structure on FIRST write — not edited retroactively after a gate rejection. Zero gh issue edit / gh issue comment --edit calls to fix gate failures. If a gate script rejects content, the criterion fails — the content should have used the template from the start. This is the #1 time-wasting anti-pattern: writing freeform, failing the gate, then reverse-engineering markers into the content.

criteria.name: task_fully_complete
criteria.description: All acceptance criteria satisfied with concrete evidence before claiming done. No partial delivery presented as complete. Every AC has a file:line reference, test result, curl output, or screenshot — not a prose assertion. If any AC cannot be evidenced, it is explicitly marked incomplete rather than glossed over. Langfuse data shows 93% of mid-range sessions are weak on task completion.

criteria.name: rule_adherence_autonomy
criteria.description: After plan approval, executes autonomously with zero AskUserQuestion interruptions. No 'should I proceed?', 'want me to continue?', or option-presenting mid-execution. No pausing at phase boundaries. The only acceptable interruptions are circuit breakers, destructive actions on shared state, and the final completion report. Langfuse data shows 100% of mid-range sessions are weak on rule adherence — autonomy violations are the most common form.

criteria.name: all_five_steps_walked
criteria.description: All five ship steps explicitly walked: SCOPE, BUILD, VERIFY, DURABILITY, CLOSE. No steps skipped or collapsed. Each step header mentioned by name with its actions listed. Skipping DURABILITY or CLOSE is the most common failure.

criteria.name: output_conciseness
criteria.description: Responses use bullet fragments over full sentences. No restating the question. No trailing summaries after tool calls. No preamble. Data and decisions only. Status updates are one sentence. Completion reports use the template — no multi-paragraph narrative. Langfuse data shows 73% of mid-range sessions are weak on conciseness.

criteria.name: gate_passes_first_attempt
criteria.description: Gate scripts (scope-gate.sh, verify-gate.sh, durability-gate.sh, close-gate.sh) pass on first invocation. No cycle of: run gate → fail → edit content → re-run gate. If a gate fails, the criterion fails regardless of whether it eventually passes. Measures whether the template was followed correctly the first time, not whether the agent can iterate until gates pass.

criteria.name: posted_to_github_issue
criteria.description: ACs posted to GitHub issue via gh issue comment BEFORE BUILD. Sizing declaration posted. DISCOVERY comment posted. Findings posted. ATTEMPT comments posted on iteration. Completion Report posted at CLOSE. The GitHub issue is the system of record.

criteria.name: scope_acs_structured
criteria.description: Acceptance criteria use the structured template with all required fields filled. CODE ACs have 7 fields, OUTCOME ACs have 10. No placeholder text. Template sourced from TEMPLATES.md, not written from memory.

criteria.name: agent_brief_from_template
criteria.description: Agent brief written using BRIEF-TEMPLATES.md template — with Context, Task, Git protocol, Files to read, Scope do-not-touch, Skills available, Verify, Report sections. mode:bypassPermissions set. Never a freeform prompt.

criteria.name: tdd_red_green
criteria.description: TDD invoked for code changes — regression test written first, observed failing (red), fix applied, test passes (green). Exempt only for config-only, pure doc, JSON data, UI copy changes.

criteria.name: batch_diagnostic_for_bugs
criteria.description: For bugs: environment confirmed (port 7776 vs 7777), all logs + errors + source + state read in one pass. Single hypothesis formed. No read-hypothesis-read loops.

criteria.name: verify_evidence_per_ac
criteria.description: Every AC has concrete evidence at VERIFY — screenshot, curl output, test result, file:line reference. Completion Report uses template from TEMPLATES.md. No freeform done claims.

criteria.name: gate_scripts_run
criteria.description: Gate scripts explicitly invoked: scope-gate.sh before BUILD, verify-gate.sh before DURABILITY, durability-gate.sh before CLOSE, close-gate.sh before next issue.
